title: Automation 101
name: Automation 101: How to Automate Your Business
seoTitle: Free Automation Course: Automation 101 for Business Owners
description: A free, eight-lesson course on business automation: how workflows work, what to automate first, how apps connect, choosing a platform, testing, and measuring ROI.
lead: Eight short lessons that take you from “we should automate something” to a clear plan for your first workflow. No technical background needed, no sign-up, and a quick knowledge check at the end of every lesson.
audience: Business owners, managers, and team members who want to cut repetitive work but are not sure where to start. If you can use a spreadsheet, you can follow this course.
outcomes: Explain how triggers, actions, and conditions make a workflow
Find and rank the tasks in your business worth automating
Map a process so it is ready to automate
Understand how apps connect through integrations, APIs, and webhooks
Choose between Zapier, Make, n8n, and custom builds
Test, monitor, and measure an automation so it keeps paying off
faq: Is this automation course really free?
Yes. Every lesson is free to read, with no sign-up. Your progress is saved in your browser so you can pick up where you left off.
No. The course explains every concept in plain language. Where a lesson touches on technical ideas such as APIs or webhooks, it focuses on what they do for you rather than how to code them.
How long does the course take?
About an hour in total. Each lesson takes around eight minutes and ends with a three-question knowledge check.
What should I do after finishing?
Take the free AI at Work 101 course to add AI to your workflows, score your own task list with the priority scorer, or book a free consultation to plan your first build.
